beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Grading and OCR now stay responsive while background analysis, tag-region detection, and retry work continue.

Fixes:
• Fixed PaddleOCR and other OCR operations blocking the grading window or hanging when native OCR work was already busy.
• Fixed interrupted grading jobs losing their resume path or retrying after the crash-loop guard had given up. Review panels now explain repeated interruptions clearly.
• Fixed OCR retries across asynchronous PDF and image conversions so recoverable samples can continue processing without restarting the whole review.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
